title: Protocol assumes 1 Stable = 1 USD
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  In the ClaimCore contract constructor, the prices for USDC and USDT are hardcoded to 1 USD:  ```solidity         if (_stargateUsdc != address(0)) {             numeratorUsdc = 1 * 10 ** (IERC20Metadata(IOFT(_stargateUsdc).token()).decimals() - 1);         }          if (_stargateUsdt != address(0)) {             numeratorUsdt = 1 * 10 ** (IERC20Metadata(IOFT(_stargateUsdt).token()).decimals() - 1);         } ```  This assumption can lead to problems during stablecoin volatility events.
